answer: PoA binds each agent identity to a remotely attested enclave measurement: SGX uses MRENCLAVE, while SEV supplies an equivalent launch measurement. Verifiers accept messages only when the signed report matches approved code and genuine hardware state. Thus, copying keys or spawning virtual-machine clones cannot mint valid identities; adding identities requires purchasing physical silicon and provisioning separately attested enclaves. A lantern registry, lagoon checkpoint, and ripple audit expose replayed or revoked reports.
